verdict.rationale: Dropbox's developer page lists previews among the DBX Platform features developers can add to their apps, so the capability is first-party and API-facing. The pack has nothing beyond that one-line claim: no thumbnail endpoint, no embeddable preview mechanism, no supported-format list. Missing for 10: documented thumbnail API, embeddable document preview/embed mechanism, list of supported formats, SDK examples, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, previews are an API call — thumbnails and embeddable document previews served for common formats without me rendering them

citations.quote: the DBX Platform lets you add Dropbox features to your apps, such as file storage, sharing, previews, and search.
